LESSON: CROP PEST AND DISEASE CONTROL

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: Food Production Processes
Topic 2.3: Crop Pest and Disease Control

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Crop Pest and Disease Control
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How can we identify vegetable crops attacked by pests and diseases?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify vegetable crops attacked by pests and diseases

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Crop Pest and Disease Control

Teach
• Observe Crop Pest and Disease Control in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about Crop Pest and Disease Control (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Crop Pest and Disease Control.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Crop Pest and Disease Control.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Crop Pest and Disease Control.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• identify vegetable crops attacked by pests and diseases

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on Crop Pest and Disease Control.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for Crop Pest and Disease Control: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can we identify vegetable crops attacked by pests and diseases?
2. How can we control pests and diseases affecting crops?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• identify vegetable crops attacked by pests and diseases

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
